parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "QueryString": "WITH
-- VIP deposit attempts over three days: D-3, D-2, D-1 (today is excluded).
-- Three days, not two: the extra day builds yesterday's 48h window, which is what
-- suppresses a repeat alert for a player who was already reported yesterday.
dep AS (
    SELECT
        r.player_id,
        r.brand,
        r.create_date,
        r.transaction_status,
        r.cnt_transaction,
        r.amount_eur,
        r.currency,
        r.country,
        r.risk_casino_segment,
        r.decline_reason_groupname,
        r.decline_reason_message,
        r.method_transaction,
        r.provider,
        r.payment_method_type
    FROM operator_ro_normcasino.agg_billing_report_hyper r
    WHERE r.create_date >= DATE_ADD('day', -3, CURRENT_DATE)
      AND r.create_date < CURRENT_DATE
      AND r.transaction_type = 'deposit'
      -- NULL is treated as "not a test", so a missing flag never hides a real VIP.
      AND COALESCE(r.is_test, false) = false
      -- Brands excluded here are not alerted on. Same list as the analytics report.
      AND r.brand NOT IN ('SBNORM', 'VOLKCASINO', 'IKRACASINO')
      -- The one line that defines "who is VIP".
      AND r.risk_casino_segment IN ('VIP-Silver', 'VIP-Gold', 'VIP-Platinum')
),
-- Collapse to player x brand x day. New is the trigger, Fail is context.
dep_day AS (
    SELECT
        d.player_id,
        d.brand,
        d.create_date,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.transaction_status = 'Success' THEN d.cnt_transaction ELSE 0 END) AS success_cnt,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.transaction_status = 'New' THEN d.cnt_transaction ELSE 0 END) AS new_cnt,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.transaction_status = 'Fail' THEN d.cnt_transaction ELSE 0 END) AS fail_cnt,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.transaction_status = 'New' THEN d.amount_eur ELSE 0 END) AS new_amount_eur,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.transaction_status = 'Fail' THEN d.amount_eur ELSE 0 END) AS fail_amount_eur
    FROM dep d
    GROUP BY d.player_id, d.brand, d.create_date
),
-- Two 48h windows shifted by a day: current [D-2, today) and yesterday's [D-3, D-1).
windows AS (
    SELECT
        dd.player_id,
        dd.brand,
        SUM(CASE WHEN dd.create_date >= DATE_ADD('day', -2, CURRENT_DATE) THEN dd.new_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS new_cnt_cur,
        SUM(CASE WHEN dd.create_date >= DATE_ADD('day', -2, CURRENT_DATE) THEN dd.success_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS success_cnt_cur,
        SUM(CASE WHEN dd.create_date >= DATE_ADD('day', -2, CURRENT_DATE) THEN dd.fail_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS fail_cnt_cur,
        SUM(CASE WHEN dd.create_date >= DATE_ADD('day', -2, CURRENT_DATE) THEN dd.new_amount_eur ELSE 0 END) AS new_amount_eur_cur,
        SUM(CASE WHEN dd.create_date >= DATE_ADD('day', -2, CURRENT_DATE) THEN dd.fail_amount_eur ELSE 0 END) AS fail_amount_eur_cur,
        SUM(CASE WHEN dd.create_date < DATE_ADD('day', -1, CURRENT_DATE) THEN dd.new_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS new_cnt_prev,
        SUM(CASE WHEN dd.create_date < DATE_ADD('day', -1, CURRENT_DATE) THEN dd.success_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS success_cnt_prev
    FROM dep_day dd
    GROUP BY dd.player_id, dd.brand
),
-- Alert condition plus deduplication: only players who became stuck today.
candidates AS (
    SELECT
        w.player_id,
        w.brand,
        w.new_cnt_cur,
        w.fail_cnt_cur,
        w.new_amount_eur_cur,
        w.fail_amount_eur_cur
    FROM windows w
    WHERE w.new_cnt_cur > 0                                     -- a pending deposit exists
      AND w.success_cnt_cur = 0                                 -- nothing was approved
      AND NOT (w.new_cnt_prev > 0 AND w.success_cnt_prev = 0)   -- and it did not already hold yesterday
),
-- The last unfinished attempt: what the player paid with, and through whom.
last_new AS (
    SELECT
        ln.player_id,
        ln.brand,
        ln.create_date,
        ln.currency,
        ln.country,
        ln.risk_casino_segment,
        ln.method_transaction,
        ln.provider,
        ln.payment_method_type
    FROM (
        SELECT
            d.player_id,
            d.brand,
            d.create_date,
            d.currency,
            d.country,
            d.risk_casino_segment,
            d.method_transaction,
            d.provider,
            d.payment_method_type,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY d.player_id, d.brand
                ORDER BY d.create_date DESC, d.amount_eur DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM dep d
        WHERE d.create_date >= DATE_ADD('day', -2, CURRENT_DATE)
          AND d.transaction_status = 'New'
    ) ln
    WHERE ln.rn = 1
),
-- Context only: the last provider decline in the same window, if there was one.
-- A New transaction carries no decline reason, and the reason is what a manager acts on.
last_fail AS (
    SELECT
        lf.player_id,
        lf.brand,
        lf.create_date AS fail_date,
        lf.decline_reason_groupname,
        lf.decline_reason_message
    FROM (
        SELECT
            d.player_id,
            d.brand,
            d.create_date,
            d.decline_reason_groupname,
            d.decline_reason_message,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY d.player_id, d.brand
                ORDER BY d.create_date DESC, d.amount_eur DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM dep d
        WHERE d.create_date >= DATE_ADD('day', -2, CURRENT_DATE)
          AND d.transaction_status = 'Fail'
    ) lf
    WHERE lf.rn = 1
)
SELECT
    c.player_id,
    c.brand,
    n.risk_casino_segment AS vip_segment,
    CAST(c.new_cnt_cur AS BIGINT) AS pending_attempts_48h,
    -- Cast through double: ROUND on decimal(38,18) hits the precision limit.
    ROUND(CAST(c.new_amount_eur_cur AS DOUBLE), 2) AS pending_amount_eur_48h,
    CAST(n.create_date AS VARCHAR) AS last_attempt_date,
    n.currency AS currency,
    n.country AS country,
    n.method_transaction AS payment_method,
    n.provider AS provider,
    n.payment_method_type AS method_type,
    -- Context: whether provider declines happened alongside, for how much, and why.
    CAST(c.fail_cnt_cur AS BIGINT) AS declined_attempts_48h,
    ROUND(CAST(c.fail_amount_eur_cur AS DOUBLE), 2) AS declined_amount_eur_48h,
    f.decline_reason_groupname AS decline_group,
    f.decline_reason_message AS decline_message
FROM candidates c
JOIN last_new n
  ON n.player_id = c.player_id
 AND n.brand = c.brand
LEFT JOIN last_fail f
  ON f.player_id = c.player_id
 AND f.brand = c.brand
-- Ordered by everything the player tried to deposit in 48h, pending and declined together.
-- Pending alone floated small amounts to the top and buried a VIP with 32 declines on
-- 835 EUR in sixth place — that is the player to call first.
ORDER BY (c.new_amount_eur_cur + c.fail_amount_eur_cur) DESC, c.player_id",
  "QueryExecutionContext": { "Database": "{{ $('Config').first().json.athenaDatabase }}", "Catalog": "{{ $('Config').first().json.athenaCatalog || 'AwsDataCatalog' }}" },
  "WorkGroup": "{{ $('Config').first().json.athenaWorkgroup || 'primary' }}",
  "ClientRequestToken": "n8n-vip-deposit-alert-execution-{{ $execution.id }}"
  {{ $('Config').first().json.athenaOutputLocation ? ', "ResultConfiguration": { "OutputLocation": "' + $('Config').first().json.athenaOutputLocation + '" }' : '' }}
}

nodes.name: Execute Athena Query
nodes.notes: ClientRequestToken is derived from the execution id, so a retry of this node rejoins the same Athena query instead of starting a second one.

nodes.name: Poll Attempts Remaining?
nodes.notes: true -> wait and poll again; false -> give up after 120 polls (~10 min)

nodes.name: Stuck VIPs Found?
nodes.notes: true -> alert digest; false -> all-clear message. Zero candidates is a normal night, not a failure.

nodes.name: Build All-Clear Payload
nodes.notes: Disconnect this node from Stuck VIPs Found? to keep quiet nights silent.

nodes.name: HTTP Request — Send VIP Alert to Slack
nodes.notes: One POST per execution: either the alert digest or the all-clear message, both to slackWebhookUrl.
